title: Performance Tuning & Optimization
description: Master SQL Server performance tuning with execution plans, statistics, indexing strategies, and Query Store.
longDescription: This module teaches you how to diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks in SQL Server. You will learn to read execution plans, optimize queries, maintain statistics, use Database Engine Tuning Advisor, and leverage Query Store for continuous performance monitoring.
whatYouLearn: Read and interpret SQL Server execution plans to identify bottlenecks
Apply query optimization techniques including predicate pushdown and join reordering
Maintain and update statistics for optimal query performance
Use Database Engine Tuning Advisor to recommend indexes and partitions
Leverage Query Store for tracking and forcing query plans
